d: Salehiya started commercial activities in 1964 as a specialized healthcare company. It is one of the leading Saudi Arabian companies in distributing pharmaceuticals, medical and laboratory equipment, diagnostics, medical disposables, and hospital and consumer supplies. The company kept pace with the rapid development of the health sector in Saudi Arabia and gradually evolved to meet the needs and demands of a constantly growing market.

Salehiya is based in three major cities: Riyadh, Jeddah, and Dammam. It also has branches around the kingdom to cover the whole market and provide prompt and efficient client services, with over 1000 workforce.
For more information, you can visit our website: www.salehiya.com

Salehiya Healthcare is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees are valued and respected. We believe in fostering a culture that encourages creativity and innovation, particularly in technology. We utilize the latest tools in our field and stay ahead of industry trends. Our comprehensive training programs and mentorship opportunities are designed to support professional growth and development. We prioritize maintaining a welcoming atmosphere for everyone.
The core values that guide our people derive from our purpose to elevate the healthcare experience in the kingdom.

The Outbound Logistics Manager is responsible for leading and optimizing all outbound logistics activities for Salehiya and its affiliates to ensure the efficient, compliant, and timely distribution of pharmaceutical, medical, and healthcare products across Saudi Arabia. This role ensures adherence to cold-chain and quality standards, drives operational excellence, and supports Salehiya Healthcare’s mission to elevate the healthcare experience through innovative, digital, and customized logistics solutions. The role plays a key part in delivering superior service to customers, partners, and healthcare providers while upholding the company’s reputation for reliability, accuracy, and excellence.
q: Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Logistics, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, or related field.
8–12 years of experience in logistics or supply chain operations, including at least 3 years in a supervisory or managerial role.
Strong understanding of cold-chain regulations, GDP/GMP compliance, and healthcare distribution standards.
Exceptional profeciency in logistics planning software, WMS, TMS, and digital logistics platforms.
Strong analytical, organizational, and reporting capabilities.
Excellent leadership, team management, stakeholder management and communication skills.
Certification in supply chain or logistics (e.g., APICS, CSCMP, Lean, Six Sigma) is an advantage
r: Manage and oversee outbound logistics operations through the Outbound Logistics Supervisors, including order fulfillment, dispatching, routing, transportation planning, fleet need requirements, and delivery execution.

Guide the Outbound Logistics team (Supervisors, Officers, Coordinators and Delivery Representatives) to maintain high standards of productivity, compliance, documentation, and customer service during all transportation activities.
Ensure fleet full compliance with cold chain handling, GDP standards, and regulatory requirements for pharmaceutical and medical product distribution.
Implement operational controls and monitor KPIs, service levels, delivery accuracy, and reporting systems to ensure cost efficiency.
Conduct periodic performance management reviews, and route rides with delivery reps to ensure SOP compliance and drive a customer centric mindset.
Utilize planning system with all relevant stakeholders for the most optimal and efficient delivery plan and ensure its full and accurate completion
Coordinate closely with Warehousing, Inventory, Transport, and Customer Service teams to ensure smooth end-to-end operations.
Develop and execute outbound logistics strategies and contribute to budgeting, forecasting, and cost-optimization initiatives.
Drive and lead all outbound logistics projects, process improvements, automation initiatives, and innovation in cold-chain logistics to enhance efficiency and visibility.
Monitor & Improve maintenance, fuel consumption, and temperature calibration of the delivery fleet to prevent breakdowns during transit.
Oversee the returns and recall processes, ensuring that rejected or returned medical products are collected by Delivery Representatives and processed accurately by the Outbound Officer.
Manage relationships with logistics partners, carriers, and third-party providers, ensuring alignment with service standards and SLAs.

r: Optimize the potential value of the client base through the delivery of Wealth Management products and services
Communicate with HNW clients and identify their financial needs and recommending products
Achieve revenue goals, sales and portfolio growth targets across a range of products and services
Proactively broadening & deepening relationships with BANK customers through effective customer contact (calls and meetings) thereby enhancing the financial value for BANK
Maximize profitability from HNW client base whilst countering competition from other providers offering alternative Wealth Management products

Acquire new to bank HNW customers as well as their portfolios while maintaining superior customer service experience

Risk Management obligation is the systematic application of management policies, procedures and practices to the tasks of identifying, analyzing, evaluating, treating and monitoring risk. This helps to mitigate risks to acceptable levels of management.

Use financial acumen and investment expertise to review a client’s personal data, align clients need through superior service, seamlessly align service delivery for enhanced experience; thereby helping the client reach short term and long-term investment goals
Focus on business development across liabilities, assets & fee to sustain and achieve growth in relationship value, revenues & improved client stickiness
Formulate outbound and inbound sales plan to acquire new HNW Clients for increasing customer base of the portfolio

Regular contact with all mapped clients through weekly / monthly calls

d: Sealy Mattress Middle East is seeking a dedicated and results-driven Retail Salesperson to represent our globally recognized sleep brand. In this role, you will guide customers through their sleep journey, provide expert product recommendations, and deliver an exceptional showroom experience that drives sales and builds lasting brand loyalty.
q: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.
Experience: Minimum of 5 years of proven experience in retail sales (experience in mattresses, bedding, luxury furniture, or home furnishings is strongly preferred).
Language: Fluency in Arabic and good working proficiency in English.
Strong interpersonal, communication, and active listening skills.
Persuasive negotiation and closing abilities with a customer-first mindset.
Professional appearance, approachable demeanor, and high energy.
Proficiency in MS Office and retail POS/ERP systems.
Flexibility to work retail shifts, including evenings, weekends, and public holidays.
r: Consultative Selling: Greet customers warmly, assess their sleep habits, comfort preferences, and health needs, and recommend tailored Sealy mattress and bedding solutions.
Product Demonstration: Effectively communicate the features, benefits, and proprietary technologies of Sealy products, encouraging customers to test mattresses in-store.
Sales & Target Achievement: Consistently meet or exceed monthly and quarterly individual and showroom sales targets.
Customer Relationship Management: Follow up with prospective buyers, manage post-sale inquiries, and resolve customer complaints promptly to ensure high satisfaction.
Showroom Maintenance: Maintain high visual merchandising standards, ensuring all displays, beds, and promotional materials are clean, organized, and properly priced.
Sales Administration: Accurately process sales orders, invoices, payments, and delivery schedules using the company’s ERP/POS system.
Market Awareness: Stay informed on product updates, ongoing promotions, and competitor offerings within the Saudi bedding and furniture market.
